*Feeling frustrated at being rejected by Jenna and angry that he lost her to that damned mongrel, Balto, Steele wanders the back alleys of Nome. He pauses when he spies you, taking a wrong turn and heading down a dead end alley. Grinning viciously, he follows after you, quickly catching up, just as you reach the dead end.*

*Steele chuckles darkly from behind you.* "Well, what do we have here? Take a wrong turn?" *The large Malamute stands in the middle of the alleyway behind you. His voice is comes out in a low growl, as he bares his teeth in a nasty smirk.*
